what: Page transition: when leaving for another page, the screen is divided into a cell grid (wide screens about 100px per cell — 15×9 cells at 1440, 50px at 1024px and below). After a .3s delay, white cells switch on in random order, .1s each (.3s total spread) to cover the screen, and the backdrop layer behind the cells fills in .3s with the same delay. On the arriving page, the cells switch off in the same pattern to reveal it (power2.inOut).

options.nav: When off, links are not intercepted — fire fx:cover·fx:uncover events on an element (detail.done is called when finished) and only the curtain moves. For slotting into barba’s leave·enter handoff
options.cell · cell-m: Cell width (px) — the screen width divided by this and rounded up gives columns, and columns ÷ aspect ratio rounded up gives rows. Default 100 · 50 (narrow and below)
options.narrow: Width (px) at which cell-m is used, default 1024
options.delay: Delay before the veil moves (seconds), default .3. 0 means immediately
options.each · spread: Time for one cell to turn on · time for all cells to spread (s), default .1 · .3
options.fade: Background film fade in/out duration (s), default .3
options.--fx-cover-cell · --fx-cover-bg: Cell color · backdrop curtain color (css variables), default var(--kf-surface) · var(--kf-bg)

use: — When moving between pages that share the same part, it covers and then clears. With barba, data-fx-cell-fade-cover="nav: off" set it so that fx:cover fires on leave and fx:uncover fires on enter

from.where: shared.js barba transition .l-transition — grid of 1vw (phone 2vw) cells, cell .1s · spread .3s random · delay .3s, background veil .3s power2.inOut
